answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 160688 Country: India Title: About qsar namaz Question: I am a student and I am studying in Aligarh in holidays usually I go to my home town Gorakhpur where my parents live. Sometime I go for 1 month or 10 days, so is it wajib to offer qasr salah or full salah? Answer ID: 160688 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 944/899/H=8/1439) Perhaps Gorakhpur is yours as well as your parents’ native place. If it is so then as soon as you enter in Gorakhpur city you will remain no longer a musafir and you will offer full salah. No matter you go there only for one month or ten days or less than it, in each case you will not offer qasr salah there rather you will offer full salah. This is the ruling pertaining to native place. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
